guia.what: Sequential navigation between content pages—links to the previous and next page at the end of an article, with each destination’s title.
whenUse: The content has an intended reading order, like a guide, a tutorial, or a chapter.
When people finish a page, moving on to the next one is the natural step.
You want to show where each side leads, not just an arrow.
whenAvoid: It’s a dataset split into numbered pages → `pagination`.
There’s no real order between the pages → `sidebar` or `toc`.
dos: Show the destination’s title, not just “Next.”
On the first or last page, show only one side. Don’t invent destinations.
donts: Don’t use it when the order is arbitrary. It promises a sequence that doesn’t exist.
